description: Use this when the user wants to know how much of their bank deposits are FDIC insured. Takes up to 30 accounts (FDIC cert, ownership category, balance, owners, trust beneficiaries), checks each bank in live FDIC records, and applies $250,000 per owner per bank per ownership category, joint shares, and the 2024 trust rule ($250,000 per beneficiary, up to 5). Returns insured and uninsured totals per bank and category, a PDF worksheet and a CSV. The result is an estimate; it does not replace FDIC EDIE and does not cover credit unions.

accounts.description: Accounts to estimate, e.g. [{"cert":3511,"category":"single","balance":300000}]. Up to 30.

balance.description: Account balance in US dollars, e.g. 180000.50. Include accrued interest if known.

beneficiaries.description: Trust accounts only: number of eligible beneficiaries named, e.g. 3 (0 to 50).

category.description: FDIC ownership category, e.g. single. One of: single, joint, retirement (IRA and other self-directed retirement accounts), trust (revocable such as POD/living trust, or irrevocable), business (corporation, partnership, unincorporated association), employee_benefit_plan, government.

cert.description: FDIC certificate number of the bank, e.g. 3511. Find it with find_bank.

label.description: Optional nickname shown in the worksheet, e.g. Savings.

owners.description: Owner names or labels. One label for most categories (default "you"), e.g. ["you"]; 2 to 10 co-owners for joint, e.g. ["you", "spouse"]. Use the same label for the same person across accounts.

name: estimate_deposit_coverage
title: Estimate FDIC deposit coverage
